slot.brief: Binomial distribution: find the probability of exactly/at least r successes, or recover the parameters given two probabilities.

stem: A binomial random variable $X$ satisfies $P(X=0)=\dfrac{1}{16}$ and $P(X=1)=\dfrac{1}{4}$. Find $P(X\ge 2)$.
working:
$\dfrac{P(X=1)}{P(X=0)}=\dfrac{np}{1-p}=4$, and $(1-p)^n=\dfrac{1}{16}$.
Thus $p=\dfrac{4}{n+4}$ and $\left(\dfrac{n}{n+4}\right)^n=\dfrac{1}{16}$, giving $n=4$, $p=\dfrac{1}{2}$.
$P(X\ge2)=1-P(X=0)-P(X=1)=1-\dfrac{1}{16}-\dfrac{1}{4}=\dfrac{11}{16}$.

Independent check: P(X\ge 2)=1-P(X=0)-P(X=1)=1-\frac{1}{16}-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{11}{16}.

draft.stem: A binomial random variable $X$ satisfies $P(X=0)=\dfrac{1}{16}$ and $P(X=1)=\dfrac{1}{4}$. Find $P(X\ge 2)$.
